module: "Load/Save" section of the Dynamic Decals tool. Lets you save the layer stack to a `.dyndecals.json` project file ("Save as..." / "Save") and load one ("Load from file") in Overwrite (replace) or Append (add) mode. The default folder is /art/dynamicDecals/projects/. The last used path is kept across extension reloads (onSerialize / onDeserialized).
notes: After a load, if res.status.code ~= 0, the response is displayed with dump() and a "Baking Issues" warning-level notification is added.
The "Save" button is disabled as long as the current path has no extension (i.e. remains the default folder).
Typo in the exported name: getCurrentPorjectFilePath ("Porject").
The loading modes come from api.loadingModes (field `key`); loadingMode is 0 (Overwrite) or 1 (Append).

loadFileDialog.desc: Opens the file dialog (filter .dyndecals.json) then calls api.loadLayerStackFromFile(path, mode) and stores the path.

saveAsFileDialog.desc: Opens the "Save as" dialog (overwrite confirmation) then calls api.saveLayerStackToFile and stores the path.

getCurrentPorjectFilePath.desc: Returns the path of the last project file used (or the default folder).

onSerialize.desc: Extension reload hook: returns {lastProjectFilePath} to keep.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload with the data from onSerialize; restores lastProjectFilePath (default: projects folder).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets API, notification and docs, prepares the list of loading modes, registers the "Load/Save" section (order 20) and the "Save & Load" documentation page.
